name: 22_relativistic_selffield
title: Relativistic beam self-fields: EM vs ES+self-B vs envelope (RZ)
notes: Without the magnetic self-field (ES, no self-B) the beam blows up 1/(1-beta^2) = 3.9x faster; EM reproduces the 1/gamma^2 space-charge reduction. The beam current rises smoothly (sin^2, 1 ns) so that the TM modes of the drift tube are not rung by a step turn-on; edge radius measured at t = 3.5 ns.
